No. 1946/36 – WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 23, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT)
ACT No. 28 OF 1964 (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Ref. No.: DIK/LAN/2/30/29.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, No. 28 of 1964, (amendment) that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose:

Description of the Land to be obtained: Following lands mentioned in the preliminary plan No. 2640 of surveyor General Matara and situated in village of Bambaranda Central and Bambaranda south, Grama Niladhari Division of Rathmale in Dickwella Divisional secretariat of Matara District.

1. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Kankanamboralassa; Description: Home Garden, There are 1-5 year age teak tree, coconut tree and 5-10 year age jack tree; Claimant: Dandeniya Arachchige Sunil, Boralassa, Rathmale, Matara; Extent: 0.0356 Hectare.
2. Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: Suraweeragemakeeriya; Description: Paddy field; Claimant: Thushil Sampath Kumara Kulathunga, Katukurundugahahena, Rathmale, Matara; Extent: 0.0710 Hectare.
3. Lot No. 3 Name of the Land: Geeganadedara; Description: Home Garden; Claimant: Pathma Kulathunga Rajapaksha, Katukurundugahahena, Rathmale, Matara; Extent: 0.0151 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Dickwella Divisional Secretary’s Office on 25th January, 2016 at 10.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 16th day of January, 2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. All deeds and documents in support of the claims should be produced before me at the inquiry.
B. S. RANJITHA, Divisional Secretary, Divisional Secretariat Dickwella.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Dickwella, 16th December, 2015. 01 - 439
